# Policy CI. Runs `make check`: schema validation, semantic checks, opa check + opa test against the real
# pack, the redaction corpus, and the pack-manifest drift check.
#
# workflow_dispatch only, until the owner answers docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md Q15 (where this repo's CI runs):
# GitHub-hosted Actions billing fails on this account, and the edge's self-hosted runner is on the
# AEGIS side while this repo guards finance policy. Until then `make check` is run locally before review.
name: policy-ci

on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest        # Q15: replace with the owner's chosen runner before enabling push/PR triggers
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      OPA_VERSION: v1.20.2
      # sha256 of opa_linux_amd64_static for OPA_VERSION, from the release's published .sha256 asset
      # (fetched 2026-09-15). Bump both together.
      OPA_SHA256: 69da5179ee403d10fa11bab6cfb4ffb0d23dba5f9b682fa977db772a1da5670f
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Install validator dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt   # exact version pins
      - name: Install OPA (checksum verified)
        run: |
          curl -fsSL -o opa "https://github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/releases/download/${OPA_VERSION}/opa_linux_amd64_static"
          echo "${OPA_SHA256}  opa" | sha256sum -c -
          chmod +x opa && echo "OPA_BIN=$PWD/opa" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: make check
        run: make check
---
# Calls the shared Claude review/approve pipeline defined in core.
# See yodatech1988/core/.github/workflows/claude-review.yml and
# .github/claude-review.md (the actual rubric) for details.
#
# Needs a CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY repo secret to do
# anything -- without one this workflow no-ops with a visible notice.
#
# automerge is deliberately OFF here: review-only gate, not full automerge
# (Ops Decision Queue card review-gates-masterthread-ops-policies, resolved
# 2026-09-16). This repo already has policy-ci.yml (workflow_dispatch-only);
# this workflow adds the actual pull_request-triggered review gate that was
# missing.
name: pr-review

on:
  pull_request:
    # No `synchronize`: pushes don't re-review (see COST in claude-review.yml).
    # `labeled` is how a re-review is requested -- add the claude-review label.
    types: [opened, reopened, ready_for_review, labeled]

jobs:
  review:
    uses: yodatech1988/core/.github/workflows/claude-review.yml@main
    with:
      automerge: false
    secrets: inherit
